entities.name: PMID:25445624
observations: Liu et al. reported a two-stage Han Chinese case-control study of NCAM1 promoter variant rs2301228 and schizophrenia: Hunan discovery cohort 986 cases/1,040 controls; Yunnan replication cohort 564 cases/547 controls.
The study reported rs2301228-A as a risk allele, with allelic association in discovery and validation in the Yunnan cohort; luciferase assays indicated A down-regulated NCAM1 transcription.
Available abstract did not provide odds ratios, confidence intervals, or exact p-values.
